title: Signed measure via Jordan decomposition
statement:
Let $s$ be a signed measure on a measurable space $\Omega$, and let $s = s^+ - s^-$ be its Jordan decomposition into a pair of (finite, mutually singular) positive measures $s^+$ and $s^-$. Then for every measurable set $S \subseteq \Omega$,
\[
s(S) = s^+(S) - s^-(S),
\]
where $s^+(S)$ and $s^-(S)$ denote the real-valued measures of $S$ under the positive and negative parts.
